data.name: Lahifa
data.gender_notes: Lahifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A soft, gentle name derived from the Arabic word 'Lahfa' which means 'wind'. This name conveys a sense of grace and tranquility, symbolizing the gentle breeze that soothes the soul and brings a sense of calmness to one's life. The name Lahifa carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, wind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lahifa usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the gentle breeze of Allah's mercy and blessings.
data.etymology: Lahifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle, wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lahifa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: لحيفة
in_arabic.meaning: الحيفة، هي المرأة التي هي حارسة للحياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اللحيفة هي أسماء الله الحسنى، حيث ذكرها الله تعالى في القرآن الكريم، وهي المرأة التي هي حارسة للحياء وتنهاها من كل شیء، وتستقيم على دینها، وتحافظ على کرامةها، وقد يكون لاسم اللحيفة تأثير إيجابي على الشخص المسمى به، حيث سوف يكون له شخصية قوية ومتين، وسيحافظ على کرامة نفسه، ولا يخاف من أحد.

in_hindi.name: लहीफा
in_hindi.meaning: लहीफा, जो अपने आप को हया का रक्षक बनाती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: लहीफा नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं में बहुत महत्व का है, जो अरब भाषा से संबंधित है। इसका अर्थ है वह स्त्री जो अपने आप को हया का रक्षक बनाती है, अपने धर्म की रक्षा करती है और अपनी मर्यादा को सुरक्षित रखती है। लहीफा नाम अपने माता-पिता, परिवार और इस्लामी परंपरा के लिए बहुत महत्व का रहा है।

It is an ideal name for a woman who wants to be a role model for others and live a life of integrity and morality.
